sentences.en: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
sentences.zh: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将向为法国消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收一种全新的税收。

sentences.en: Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services.
sentences.zh: 数字服务既包括提供在线销售商品和服务的平台，也包括基于用户数据进行定向广告投放，该税种针对的是此类服务的总营收。

sentences.en: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a “GAFA tax,” meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon — in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
sentences.zh: 许多法国政界人士和媒体将这项税收称为“GAFA税”，意即它主要针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司——换句话说，即总部设在美国的跨国科技企业。

sentences.en: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 这项数字服务税现在等待法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的签署，他已表示支持该措施，这项税收可能在未来几周内生效。

sentences.en: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
sentences.zh: 但这项税收已经引发了重大争议，美国贸易代表已就这项税收是否歧视美国公司展开调查，这反过来又可能导致对法国实施贸易制裁。

sentences.en: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
sentences.zh: 法国的这项税收并不仅仅是一个急需收入的国家采取的单边行动。

sentences.en: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
sentences.zh: 相反，数字服务税是更大趋势的一部分，过去几年里，各国纷纷提出或出台了一系列五花八门的新国际税收条款。

sentences.en: These have included Britain’s DPT (diverted profits tax), Australia’s MAAL (multinational antiavoidance law), and India’s SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.
sentences.zh: 其中包括英国的DPT（转移利润税）、澳大利亚的MAAL（跨国企业反避税法）和印度的SEP（重大经济存在）测试，仅举几例。

sentences.en: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国以及其他几个国家都在认真考虑征收数字服务税。

sentences.en: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right.
sentences.zh: 这些单边行动的具体内容各不相同，但它们都旨在对跨国公司就某些收入和营收征税，而这些国家认为即使国际税收规则没有授予它们这种权利，它们也有权对此征税。

sentences.en: In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，它们都认为国际税收体系已跟不上当前经济的发展。

sentences.en: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution.
sentences.zh: 针对这些众多的单边措施，经济合作与发展组织（经合组织）目前正与131个国家合作，力争在2020年底前就一项国际解决方案达成共识。

sentences.en: Both France and the United States are involved in the organization’s work, but France’s digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system.
sentences.zh: 法国和美国都参与了该组织的工作，但法国的数字服务税和美国的回应引发了人们对国际税收体系未来的疑问。

sentences.en: France’s planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
sentences.zh: 法国计划的这项税收是一个明确的警告：除非在改革国际税收体系方面能够达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能会纷纷效仿，美国公司届时将面临来自数十个国家的层层叠叠、令人不堪重负且代价高昂的不同税收。

questions.stem: The French Senate has passed a bill to ____

options.C: impose a levy on tech multinationals.

questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干直接定位到第一段第一句话 a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services...;选项C中的“levy”和“tax”同义复现;“tech multinationals” 和digital services 同义复现。因此C为正确答案，奇遇选项均未体现。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that the digital services tax ____

options.B: is apt to arouse criticism at home and abroad.
options.C: aims to ease international trade tensions.
options.D: will prompt the tech giants to quit France.

questions.analysis: 推断题。根据提干定位到第二段，第二段第二句话but it has already sparked significant controversy,...,which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France(这已经引起了巨大的反抗，..., 反过来也会导致针对法国的贸易制裁)和选项A相一致;其中选项中的“trigger”和原文的“lead to”同义复现，“sanction”和“countermeasure”同义复现。其余选项均未体现。

questions.stem: The countries adopting the unilateral measures share the opinion that ____

options.A: redistribution of tech giants’ revenue must be ensured.
options.B: the current international tax system needs upgrading.
options.C: tech multinationals’ monopoly should be prevented.
options.D: all countries ought to enjoy equal taxing rights.

questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干定位到第四段最后一句话 “they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy(他们都认为国际税收体系并未跟上当前经济形势)。选项B目前的国际税收体系需要升级是该句话的反义复现。其余选项均为体现。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that the OECD’s current work ____

options.A: is being resisted by US companies.

questions.analysis: 细节题。根据提干定位到第五段最后一句话”raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system(对于国际税收体系的未来充满疑虑)”和选项C相一致。其中选项中的“uncertain”和原文中的“raise questions”同义复现，“prospects”和原文中的 “future”同义复现。

questions.stem: Which of the following might be the best title for this text?

options.A: France Is Confronted with Trade Sanctions
options.B: France Leads the Charge on Digital Tax
options.D: France Demands a Role in the Digital Economy
